blocks.heading: Built in the rooms where *trust was fragile*.
blocks.line: Dr. Stephen de Wit has spent years in rooms where silence spoke louder than titles. Today he helps leaders turn human tension into high-trust cultures where people stay.
paragraphs: For more than 20 years Stephen’s work has lived at the frontlines of vulnerability, conflict and connection: in transformational retreats and in research with homeless veterans and people living with dementia.
Along the way he saw what most leadership playbooks miss. When people don't feel seen, safe or heard, performance erodes.

Today he brings that lens to the stage. His Lead Human™ framework shows leaders how to clear silent friction, rebuild trust and build cultures where people lean in, step up and stay, even under pressure.

He works with executive teams and senior leaders, managers and emerging leaders, associations and professional organizations, healthcare teams, and teams working through change, growth or cultural strain.
